metadata.title: Coach Career IA — your private career agent
metadata.description: Your private career agent: your proof, your guard-rails, and only the opportunities that respect them. Anonymous by default.

footer.privacy: Your data stays yours: never sold, never shared without your consent.

landing.title: Stop job hunting. Let the right opportunities come to you.
landing.intro: Coach Career IA flips the job search around: you build a career memory grounded in proof, you set your conditions, and our agent brings you only the offers that respect them. Without exposing your identity.

anonymous.title: Anonymous by default
anonymous.text: Your identity, contact details and current employer are stored separately, encrypted. Recruiters only see an anonymised profile built on what you can do.

proofs.title: Proof, not promises
proofs.text: Your career memory gathers concrete achievements: projects delivered, measured results, demonstrated skills. They speak for you.

guardRails.title: Your guard-rails do the sorting
guardRails.text: Minimum salary, remote work, excluded sectors, commute time: you set non-negotiable rules. An offer that breaks one never reaches you.

control.title: You stay in control
control.text: Nothing goes out without your consent. When an opportunity interests you, you lift your anonymity in one click — and only for that recruiter.

steps.one: You describe your background with verifiable proof.
steps.two: You set your guard-rails, once and for all.
steps.three: The agent analyses the market and shows you only qualified offers.
steps.four: You decide, offer by offer, whether to reveal yourself.

landing.closingTitle: Your career, your rules, your pace.
landing.closingText: Passwordless sign-in, via a link sent to your email address. No data is shared without your explicit consent.

login.title: Sign in to your space
login.intro: No password: enter your email address and we’ll send you a one-time sign-in link. If you don’t have a space yet, it will be created the first time you sign in.

verify.title: Check your inbox
verify.text: If the address you entered is valid, a sign-in link has just been sent to you. It is valid for 15 minutes and works only once.
verify.help: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder, then <link>request a new link</link>.

dashboard.title: Welcome to your space
dashboard.intro: Your career agent is getting set up. Start with your career memory and your guard-rails: they will guide the selection of opportunities.

completeness.title: Profile completeness
completeness.summary: {achievements, plural, =0 {No achievements yet.} one {One achievement} other {# achievements}}{achievements, plural, =0 {} other {, {proven, plural, =0 {none proven} one {one proven} other {# proven}}.}} Achievements backed by proof count the most.
completeness.complete: Your profile is complete. Remember to keep it up to date.

addExperience.title: Add an experience
addExperience.text: Your role, its dates and a generic description of the employer.

addAchievement.title: Describe an achievement
addAchievement.text: A project, an action, a measurable result.

addProof.title: Prove an achievement
addProof.text: Attach a link, a document or a testimonial.

moreProofs.title: Prove more achievements
moreProofs.text: Three proven achievements earn the maximum score.

provenSkills.title: Three proven skills
provenSkills.text: Link your skills to proven achievements.

setSalary.title: Set your minimum salary
setSalary.text: No offer below it will be shown to you.

setLocation.title: Specify location or remote work
setLocation.text: The cities you accept and your remote-work policy.

setContractTypes.title: Choose your contract types
setContractTypes.text: Permanent, freelance, fixed-term… whatever you accept.

visibility.title: Visibility status
visibility.intro: Decide whether your anonymised profile can be shown to recruiters.

memory.title: My career memory
memory.text: Gather your achievements and the proof that backs them.

guardRails.title: My guard-rails
guardRails.text: Set the conditions no offer may break.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.text: Find the offers qualified by your agent here.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.intro: Only offers that respect your guard-rails, with an explanation of every match.
opportunities.emptyText: As soon as your career memory and guard-rails are filled in, your agent will start suggesting qualified offers.

memory.title: My career memory
memory.intro: Your concrete achievements, each backed by proof. This is the basis of your anonymised profile: no employer names, colleague names or contact details appear in it.

experiences.title: Experience
experiences.emptyText: Add your successive roles. The employer is described generically (sector, size, stage): its name is never requested.
experiences.achievementCount: {count, plural, =0 {no achievements} one {# achievement} other {# achievements}}
experiences.formIntro: Describe the role and its context without naming the employer: this is what lets us present you anonymously.
experiences.deleteText: Linked achievements are kept, simply detached from the experience.

form.roleTitleHint: For example: Back-end developer, Marketing manager.
form.employerHint: For example: “fintech scale-up with 51 to 200 people”. This is enough for matching and preserves your anonymity.
form.responsibilitiesHint: Your scope and main duties. Don’t include any company or person names.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.intro: The heart of your profile: what you did, and the result you achieved. A proven achievement is worth far more than a declared one.
achievements.emptyText: Describe a project you are proud of: the context, what you did, the measurable result. Then add proof.
achievements.proofCount: {count, plural, =0 {No proof} one {# proof} other {# proofs}}
achievements.formIntro: Be concrete: figures, timelines, impact. Avoid names of people, clients and employers.
achievements.deleteText: Its proofs, including uploaded documents, will be deleted.
achievements.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this achievement and all its proofs?

form.title: Title
form.titleHint: For example: Redesign of the checkout flow.
form.contextHint: The starting situation, what was at stake.
form.actionsHint: Your own actions, not the team’s.
form.resultHint: For example: conversion rate +18% in three months.
form.skillsHint: Comma-separated. They automatically feed your skills list.

proofs.title: Proof
proofs.intro: A public link, a private document or a written testimonial. Documents are encrypted and visible to you alone.
proofs.empty: This achievement is not proven yet. Add at least one proof for it to count fully.
proofs.urlHint: Article, code repository, public presentation, online certificate…
proofs.fileHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, {maxMb} MB maximum. Stored encrypted, never shared without your consent.
proofs.referenceHint: Copy a recommendation you received, without its author’s name or contact details.

skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: Calculated from your achievements: the level depends on the number of proven achievements, and the last-used date on the linked experience.
skills.emptyText: They appear as soon as you mention them in an achievement. You can also declare one directly.
skills.addHint: A skill declared without an achievement is marked as unproven.
skills.unprovenHint: Unproven: mention it in an achievement backed by proof.
skills.confirmDelete: Delete the skill “{name}”? It will be removed from the achievements that mention it.

guardRails.title: My guard-rails
guardRails.intro: The non-negotiable conditions an offer must meet to reach you. They are applied as strict filters.
guardRails.emptyHint: No guard-rails set yet. Start with your minimum salary and your contract types.

summary.title: Summary
summary.minFixed: Minimum base salary: {amount} gross per year

salary.title: Compensation
salary.amountHint: Below this, the offer is discarded.

location.title: Locations and remote work
location.intro: The cities around which you are willing to work, and your remote-work policy.

contracts.title: Accepted contract types
contracts.intro: No box ticked: all contract types are accepted.

exclusions.title: Exclusions
exclusions.intro: The sectors and companies you never want to receive offers from.
exclusions.companiesHint: One per line (your current employer, for example). These names are encrypted and never leave your space.

workload.title: Working pattern
workload.maxHoursHint: Leave blank if it doesn’t matter to you.
workload.onCallHint: Otherwise, roles with on-call duty are discarded.

culture.title: Company culture
culture.intro: Optional: what matters to you. These preferences refine how offers are ranked.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Your language, your data, your account.

language.title: Language
language.intro: The language of the interface, emails and texts written by your agent.

export.title: Export my data
export.intro: Download all your data (experience, achievements, proofs and documents, skills, guard-rails) in JSON format.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.intro: Immediate and permanent deletion of your account, your career memory, your guard-rails and all your documents. This action cannot be undone.
delete.confirmLabel: Confirm by entering your email address
delete.confirmHint: Remember to export your data before deleting your account.

ACTIVE.label: Actively looking
ACTIVE.description: Your anonymised profile is put forward to recruiters as a priority.

OPEN.label: Open to opportunities
OPEN.description: Your anonymised profile may be shown for highly targeted offers.

INVISIBLE.label: Invisible
INVISIBLE.description: No recruiter can see your profile. Your agent keeps watching out for you.
